summary: ASTROCARE is a browser-based astronaut health monitoring prototype developed by Team Beyond Limits using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Chart.js. It features an interactive dashboard displaying vital signs such as heart rate, SpO₂, temperature and blood pressure, alongside sleep, activity and mood indicators. It addresses the challenges of long-duration space missions by bringing essential health information into one interface, enabling easier observation of readings and trends. This project is important because astronauts face physical and behavioural changes in space, while immediate medical support may be limited. ASTROCARE aims to support crew wellbeing through accessible, research-informed health monitoring.
details:
ASTROCARE is a browser-based astronaut health-monitoring prototype designed to support crew wellbeing during long-duration space missions. It brings important health indicators, including heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), body temperature, blood pressure, sleep, physical activity and mood, into one unified dashboard. Users can enter daily readings, view health information and observe trends through visual indicators and charts.

The project aims to make health information easier to understand, encourage regular monitoring and help identify unusual changes that may require attention. Its intended impact is to support astronaut wellbeing, improve health awareness and contribute to safer, more sustainable human space exploration.

ASTROCARE was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with Chart.js for data visualisation. It is a lightweight web-based prototype that runs in a browser without requiring dedicated hardware for the demonstration. The current version uses simulated readings and manual inputs rather than live astronaut sensor data.

Its creative approach lies in combining multiple dimensions of physical and behavioural wellbeing into a single, accessible interface. During development, we considered the challenges of long-duration missions, communication delays, limited onboard resources, ease of use, data privacy, reliability and the importance of avoiding misleading medical alerts.

ASTROCARE is a foundation for future development, including NASA research dataset integration, wearable sensor connectivity, secure data storage and further validation before any real-world medical application.
